video.description:
Agentic debugging is replacing manual log hunting and console logs. Learn how to use autonomous AI agents for root cause analysis, live runtime inspection, and hypothesis-driven debugging to transition from syntax producer to architectural overseer.

📌 THE BIG PICTURE
For 3-10 years, AI functioned as a fast-typing intern, but ballooning codebases have shifted the engineering bottleneck from writing code to maintaining and fixing it. This video breaks down the transition from passive chat assistants to autonomous agentic debuggers that execute multi-step investigative workflows.
